Samir Rao: quick follow-up from the morning canary: two Dedicated hotstarts stalled when a safetensors checkpoint arrived gzipped with no index. stream path hung waiting for frame boundaries.
Tess Morgan: saw it too. traces show the stream decoder blocked on header parsing for >10s.
Evan Park: root cause looks like the registry sent gzip w/o index and our stream heuristic thought Accept-Ranges meant safe to stream.
Rohit Singh: proposal: add a tiny probe "heartbeat" header on HEAD/GET responses: `x-rw-format-heartbeat: sf|sf+gz|index-only|unknown`. edge caches this small value for short TTL so loaders can avoid probing repeatedly.
Samir Rao: heartbeat TTL proposal: 45s by default, 15s for URL-only cache when etag/last-mod missing.
Tess Morgan: alternative if header not present: loader does a quick 256B range peek and checks magic bytes (gzip vs safetensors) and index marker. cache result locally to dedupe concurrent hotstarts.
Evan Park: add an explicit manifest flag `serve_format_hint` that registries/operators can set to skip probes for trusted stores. default remains autodetect.
Rohit Singh: safety: initial stream attempt must have a short handshake timeout (400ms). if decoder doesn't see expected markers, abort and switch to index-first. log `decision=fallback` with probe method for triage.
Samir Rao: telemetry: emit probe.source=head|range|manifest, probe.result=sf|sf+gz|index|unknown, load.path=stream|index, probe.latency_ms. dashboard should break down by model and registry.
Tess Morgan: runbook changes: how to force `index-only` per-model, how to clear edge heartbeat cache, and steps to triage `decision= fallback` logs.
Evan Park: impl tasks: (1) edge header + TTL caching, (2) loader peek + local cache and short decode deadline, (3) manifest schema change and docs, (4) telemetry + dashboard, (5) runbook edits.
Rohit Singh: compatibility note: many third-party registries won't set heartbeat header. loader must treat missing as unknown and fall back to range peek or index-first.
infra-bot: created ISSUE-ML-2178: "format-heartbeat header + loader peek + manifest serve_format_hint" assigned to Samir Rao, Tess Morgan, Evan Park, Rohit Singh. ETA: 2 sprints.
Samir Rao: OK team, I'll open the RFC PR with header proto and the short decode timeout defaults. will add canary plan: 1% Dedicated hotstarts for 1 week, monitor OOMs and probe.latency.
Tess Morgan: sounds good. I'll sketch dashboard queries for probe.* metrics.
Evan Park: will implement loader changes and include a small debug endpoint to inspect local probe cache.
Rohit Singh: thanks all, syncing on PR thread. :thumbsup:
